case: custom enum[] labels through JSON, CSV, XLSX and SQL file writers
contract: A custom enum[] contains literal NULL, empty text, Unicode, comma, quote, markup and SQL NULL; pg_typeof, array_to_json and array_send provide native type, semantic and wire-byte oracles.
Binding the driver's array text as the destination enum[] reproduces native array_to_json and array_send exactly.
JSON and CSV preserve the driver's exact array text. XLSX stores it as a string cell without a formula and XML-escapes markup.
Replayed SQL restores native array text, JSON elements and wire bytes.

native_contract.command: rtk proxy cargo test --manifest-path linux/Cargo.toml -p tablepro-driver-postgres value_contract_custom_enum_array_file_exports_preserve_labels -- --ignored --nocapture

clippy.command: rtk proxy cargo clippy --manifest-path linux/Cargo.toml -p tablepro-driver-postgres --all-targets -- -D warnings

remaining: Other PostgreSQL array families and file-writer combinations, spreadsheet-application re-import and additional enum consumer/session configurations remain open.
